artworks.title: North from Storm King
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on light green  wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a body of water, likely a river, stretching horizontally. Hills and mountain slopes meet the sky in the background. The style is characterized by delicate pencil strokes, shading defining hills, rocky outcrops, and foliage. Rugged terrain with sparse vegetation is detailed with various plants and trees. The color palette is subdued and monochromatic, using pencil and faint white highlights to imply light and shadow. Small sailboats are seen in the distance on the water.

artworks.title: The Round Tower
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monumental architectural interior. The scene features a labyrinthine space with massive stone structures including arches, staircases, and bridges. Heavy cross-hatching creates a chiaroscuro effect, emphasizing the depth of the architecture. The complex network of stairs intersects at various angles, leading the eye upwards into the cavernous space. Vertical and horizontal lines fill the space. The atmosphere is grandiose and slightly ominous due to the scale and play of light and shadow. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Piranesi's etchings of architectural fantasies.

artworks.title: Alexander at the Tomb of Cyrus
artworks.medium: oil heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Edward E. MacCrone Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with a warrior and an elderly figure near an ancient monument. The warrior is depicted in detailed armor, a helmet, and a cloak, leaning forward, interacting with the seated figure. The aged figure is wearing robes and has a crown of leaves. A monumental structure can be seen in the background, along with fabric draping. The sky shows clouds and urn-like structures. The image uses warm and muted colors, creating light and shadow effects on the figures and surroundings. This painting style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo.

artworks.title: Altar for Corpus Christi Day
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural setting. The drawing showcases a grand building facade with classical architectural elements, such as columns, arches, and decorative details. At the top of the structure, there is a large crown and several sculptures of figures positioned on the roof and ledges. The central part of the building's facade leads to an entrance or a throne area. Around the building, there is a gathering of people suggesting an event or ceremony. The intricate details depict a scene that captures the grandeur and formality of the environment.

artworks.title: Caliban
artworks.description: The image shows a character named Caliban from the waist up. His upper body is in a twisted position, as if he is looking upward. He has exaggerated and monstrous facial features, including a protruding brow, a large nose, and pointed ears. His hair is wild and unkempt. He is mostly bare-chested, covered with patches of fur. One of his arms is raised, showing large claw-like fingers. The background is a simple textured oval backdrop.

artworks.title: Cormar Attacking the Spirit of the Waters (Ossian, Fingal, Book III)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in motion. The image depicts a scene with the figures engaged in a struggle or confrontation. One figure is at the center, holding a weapon and dressed in flowing garments. The background consists of swirling lines to convey motion. The figures' postures imply effort or conflict. The line work and shading add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Labourers
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a group of young boys around a cart. A horse-drawn cart is close to us, with a horse and two boys near the front of the horse. One boy sits on the cart, leaning on a bag, as two others stand by it, one seems to be speaking animatedly. A fourth boy stands slightly behind, attending to the conversation. A sleeping dog is on the ground to the left. In the distance, dense trees are visible, dark and textured, suggesting a thick forest without a horizon. Precise brushstrokes create a realistic monochromatic image with various shades of gray. The careful use of light and dark tones gives depth and a serene atmosphere, highlighting details in the clothing of the figures and the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: L'Abbe Jean-Antoine de Maroulle
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a man in profile facing to the right. The man has a prominent nose and curly hair pulled back, possibly tied at the nape of the neck. He is wearing formal attire with a high-collared garment and a large collar or cravat around his neck. The portrait is surrounded by an engraved oval with text along the perimeter, likely in French. The background within the oval is shaded with closely spaced lines. Additional elements include an emblem with cherubic figures at the bottom and some text that appears to be a dedication or a poem.

artworks.title: Capriccio: Ruins
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a classical architectural ruin from a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground, several figures interact with a large decorative urn. Beyond them, there is an archway covered in vines and foliage. Through the arch, a statue of a horseback rider can be seen. Further back, there is a row of columns hinting at a grand structure. The artwork features intricate cross-hatching and line work, typical of etchings, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of black and white etchings, giving the scene a timeless feel.

artworks.title: A Party of Life Guards
artworks.description: The image shows a group of cavalry horses and riders. Two central figures are depicted dressed in uniform with helmets and plumed headdresses; one is mounted on a horse, while the other stands beside another horse, holding a sword at his side. Several horses and riders are seen behind them, fading into the background, creating a sense of depth and movement. The composition is detailed, capturing the musculature of the horses and the folds in the uniforms, while lines suggest the ground underfoot, adding realism to the scene.

artworks.title: Representant du Peuple (Representative of thePeople)
artworks.description: The image shows a historical figure on a dark horse, positioned in the center of the composition. The individual is turned slightly to the side, with one leg bent, steering the horse. The person has distinct facial features adorned with a mustache and is wearing a large hat with a feather plume. The attire consists of elaborate military clothing, complete with a sash across the torso and long riding boots. The individual also has a scabbard indicating a sheathed sword. Surrounding this figure are soldiers in formation, outfitted in military uniforms with rifles held upright. The background is filled with smoke and indistinct figures.

artworks.title: Two Buffaloes and a Herdsman
artworks.description: The image shows a side view with the horizon positioned low. In the foreground, three water buffalo are depicted, detailed with textured lines to show their muscular forms. A figure is also present on the left, guiding the buffalo with a stick. The upper half of the image depicts clouds, suggesting a slightly overcast day. The landscape includes gentle hills and sparse vegetation, rendered in monochrome to create depth.

artworks.title: Young Woman and a Boy Facing Right
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the shoulders up. The person in the foreground is positioned in profile with their face turned to the side, their hair styled back. Their facial features include a smooth forehead, high cheekbones, and a pointed chin. They are dressed in a garment with visible folds and textures. The other individual is slightly behind and closer to the background, with curly hair partially covered by a loosely draped cloth or headscarf. Their expression appears focused on the first individual. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Gentleman Lounging in a Chair
artworks.medium: red chalk with touches of black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a chair. The individual leans to one side, with one arm on the armrest and the other supporting their head. The person has a neutral facial expression and wavy hair pulled back. They wear historical attire, including a long coat, knee-length pants, and pointed shoes. The background is minimalistic, with textured patterns.

artworks.title: A Nude Model Arranging Flowers
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a nude individual bending forward at the waist. They are positioned over a vase or bowl with flowers. The background is minimal and sketchy, with light pencil shading.

artworks.title: The Dream of Mordecai
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 22.6 x 17.2 cm (8 7/8 x 6 3/4 in.)
support: 30 x 24.2 cm (11 13/16 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of celestial beings and creatures in a mythological scene. The drawing shows a grandiose spectacle with figures in various stages of action and contemplation. In the top section, winged figures are assembled around two dragon-like creatures, set against a backdrop of light from a sun. Below, a bearded figure draped in a garment is reclining on a raised platform, looking towards the scene above. The drawing uses sepia ink washes, giving it an ancient and elegant appearance.

artworks.title: Garden Party at a Country House
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is not visible, and there are tall trees and a building on the right. The building has classical columns and an ornate entrance partially obscured by trees. The trees are rendered with fine brushstrokes in a limited sepia color palette. Well-dressed individuals are engaged in various leisurely activities, such as conversing, dining, dancing, and preparing beverages. More trees are visible in the distance, creating a sense of enclosed natural beauty. The scene conveys elegance and sociability in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Saints Nicholas, Ulrich, and Erasmus
artworks.description: The image shows three people in long ceremonial robes standing close together. They are holding large staffs and wearing elaborate miters on their heads. The central person holds a book while the person on the left also holds a book or a similar object. Their facial features are detailed, with distinct expressions and beards visible on the left and right individuals. The clothing has intricate patterns, emphasizing the robes and miters. In the background, there is a large column and arched architectural elements, with several birds visible in the sky on the left.

artworks.title: Cliff on a Seashore
artworks.medium: woodcut with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with rocky cliffs, a small settlement, and distant ships on the horizon. The style is reminiscent of a woodcut with bold lines, crosshatching, and a limited color palette of primarily blue, black, and white.

artworks.title: Two Cows under a Tree
artworks.description: The image depicts cows in a landscape. The point of view is eye level, showing the cows and surrounding area. The horizon is in the top third of the image with distant hills meeting the sky. Detailed line work creates texture. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on brown shades. A cow stands near a tree, with another cow lying down nearby. In the background, there is lush foliage and distant landscape elements.

artworks.title: Bibi Lalouette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a child seated, facing left. Their curly hair is tousled, their facial features are in profile, and they wear a loose garment. In their lap, there is a book or object with a dark cover. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed line engraving of a male figure in a relaxed pose with one foot forward and the other back. The man leans against a staff held in his left hand, with his head turned to the left. He has a strong jawline, full beard, and curly hair falling to his shoulders. The man wears draped garments and an ornate vine belt. The background shows an archway with decorative elements, including sculptural figures on top and an inscription saying "SATVRNVS." Rich architectural details surround the figure.

artworks.title: Neptune
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular figure in a powerful pose with legs slightly apart, facing forward. The figure has a defined face with a beard and flowing hair. They are draped in a cloth around their waist, holding a trident in one hand and a bundle of reeds or plants in the other. The background includes an arch above the figure and two winged cherubs in flight.

artworks.title: Pluto
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular man holding a two-pronged staff. He is in a strong stance with one foot forward and one foot slightly back. He has a full beard, curly hair, and is looking to the side. He is standing in front of an architectural background with a rounded arch, two columns, and decorative elements. The engraving details highlight contrast and texture. The name "PLVTO" is inscribed above the figure.
